tools.description: Send a conversation to any text model available through CCAPI (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, Qwen…) and get the reply. Useful for consulting a second model for a different perspective, running a cheap model over bulk work, or reaching a model the current client does not have configured. Responses are non-streaming.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Omit for the model default.

messages.description: Conversation so far, oldest first. Must contain at least one message.

role.description: Message author: system, user or assistant.

model.description: Exact model name, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 or deepseek-v4-pro. Call list_models with category 'text' if unsure.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences that stop generation.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, typically 0-2. Omit for the model default.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability mass, 0-1. Omit for the model default.

tools.name: chat_completion

finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped, e.g. stop or length.

model.description: Model that actually served the request.

tools.title: Call a text model

tools.description: Report the remaining and used balance for this CCAPI key. Useful before starting an expensive batch of generations, or to explain a quota failure to the user.
tools.name: get_balance

currency.description: Unit of the amounts above, e.g. USD.

note.description: Guidance when the balance is low, unlimited, or scoped to a token.

remaining_amount.description: Remaining balance, in the account's display currency. Omitted when unlimited.

total_amount.description: Remaining plus used. Omitted when unlimited.

unlimited.description: True when this token has no spending cap, in which case the amount fields are not meaningful.

used_amount.description: Balance consumed to date, in the same unit.

tools.title: Get account balance

tools.description: Check the status of an asynchronous generation task submitted by generate_video, generate_music, generate_lyrics, extend_music, or generate_image with async=true. Pass the platform and task_id exactly as they were returned. Status is one of queued, in_progress, completed or failed; poll every few seconds until it settles, or pass wait_seconds to have the server wait for you.

platform.description: Platform the task belongs to, exactly as returned by the submit tool: image, video, suno or producer.

task_id.description: Task identifier returned by the submit tool.

wait_seconds.description: Poll server-side for up to this many seconds (max 240) and return once the task finishes. Omit for a single immediate status check.

tools.name: get_task

fail_reason.description: Why the task failed, when status is failed.

progress.description: Progress indication, when the backend reports one.

raw.description: Backend payload, for details this summary does not cover (lyrics text, per-clip metadata, seeds).

result_urls.description: Finished asset URLs. May expire; download anything worth keeping.

status.description: One of: queued, in_progress, completed, failed, unknown.

task_id.description: The task this status refers to.

tools.title: Check an async task

tools.description: List the AI models this CCAPI key can actually call, with their capability category and the MCP tool that drives them. Call this before generating anything if you are unsure a model name is valid — availability depends on the key's group and changes over time. Never guess model names.

category.description: Filter by capability. One of: text, image, video, music, embedding, other. Omit to list every model this key can use.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the model name, e.g. 'claude' or 'seedance'.

tools.name: list_models

models.description: Models available to the calling key.

category.description: Capability category: text, image, video, music, embedding or other.

description.description: Human-readable description, when the platform publishes one.

endpoints.description: API endpoint families this model supports.

groups.description: Token groups that can reach this model.

name.description: The exact model name to pass to other tools.

tool.description: Which MCP tool to call for this model. Absent means no MCP tool drives it — reach it through the REST API instead.

vendor.description: Upstream vendor, e.g. Anthropic, Google, Suno.

tools.title: List available models
